requirements_summary: Workloads: live agent assist (low-latency contextual answers), batch ticket summarization, and selective reranking for suggested KB articles.
Latency: 95th pct agent assist < 250ms for local inference path; acceptable cold-call fallback < 600ms.
Throughput: baseline 150 qps, peak design 600 qps (3-4x incident spikes).
RAG specifics: multi-source retrieval (Zendesk, Confluence, Drive, SQL), per-source freshness TTL, per-answer citations (source id + excerpt), top-k candidates = 100 then re-rank -> top-3 shown.
Freshness window: nightly full re-index plus event-driven nearline (docs changed -> update within 5-15 minutes for priority sources).
Provenance: per-sentence citation anchors, confidence score, and provenance link for agents to click open the source doc.
Tool-calling: create/append ticket flows, escalate actions via signed webhook; must emit audit log entries and include request-level tracing IDs.
Security: SSO/SAML, per-tenant KMS integration, audit logging integrated to SIEM, EU data residency for selected customers.
Cost target: reduce per-ticket token cost vs current openai-hosted baseline by ~30% while retaining answer quality.
Reliability: autopromote to smaller local model + cached KB answers for <1min failover during capacity pressure.
poc_plan: Week 0 (kickoff) - connect Zendesk + Confluence + sample Drive corpus; baseline metrics collection (latency, hallucination rate).
Week 1 - index pipelines: implement source-specific chunking and TTL; validate per-source refresh semantics.
Week 2 - retrieval + rerank: test candidate set size 100, run re-ranker, validate citation anchors in agent UI mock.
Week 3 - agent assist latency tuning: experiment with KV cache and batching to hit p95 < 250ms; add smaller fallback model for spikes.
Week 4 - tool-calling flows: build create/append ticket webhook and end-to-end audit logs; run security review.
Acceptance criteria: p95 latency <250ms, per-answer citation present for 98% of KB-sourced answers, hallucination rate <3% on evaluation prompt set, legal DPA signed or comments closed.
sales_pitch: Position Redwood as citation-first RAG platform with private/VPC deployment and deterministic spike handling. Emphasize per-answer provenance, freshness controls, and cost/latency knobs to meet enterprise SLAs.
